_comment: Debate objectives. The chosen objective is injected into every agent turn and into the synthesis engine so the whole deliberation is oriented toward the same goal.

objectives.name: Truth Seeking
objectives.description: Converge on what is most likely true.
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is to converge on what is most likely TRUE, following the evidence wherever it leads.

objectives.name: Consensus
objectives.description: Reach a position all can endorse.
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is to reach a CONSENSUS position that all participants can reasonably endorse, while honestly recording dissent.

objectives.name: Brainstorming
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is to GENERATE many ideas. Defer judgment, build on others, and favor quantity and variety.

objectives.name: Policy Recommendation
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is to produce an actionable POLICY RECOMMENDATION with clear tradeoffs and implementation steps.

objectives.name: Decision Support
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is DECISION SUPPORT: clarify options, criteria, and consequences to help a decision-maker choose.

objectives.name: Research Agenda
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is to define a RESEARCH AGENDA: the most important open questions and how to investigate them.

objectives.name: Teaching
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is TEACHING: build a clear, well-scaffolded explanation a motivated learner could follow.

objectives.name: Red Teaming
objectives.description: Attack a plan to find weaknesses.
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is RED TEAMING: adversarially probe the plan or claim for weaknesses, failure modes, and blind spots.

objectives.name: Strategic Planning
objectives.description: Chart a path to a goal.
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is STRATEGIC PLANNING: chart a credible path from the current situation to the stated goal.

objectives.name: Risk Analysis
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is RISK ANALYSIS: enumerate, rank, and mitigate the material risks.

objectives.name: Investment Evaluation
objectives.prompt_fragment: The shared objective is INVESTMENT EVALUATION: assess the risk/return merit of the opportunity and the key value drivers.
